top5.title: AI Stocks Fall After the U.S. Elections
top5.description: The Nasdaq fell 5.5%, while several chipmakers dropped more than 9% or by double digits. Wall Street fears a slowdown in data centers after the adoption of numerous local measures aimed at restricting them.
top5.why: A 5.5% Nasdaq drop and sharp declines in AI-chip stocks show that investors are reassessing the pace and economics of data-center expansion after new local restrictions.

top5.title: Mira Murati’s startup targets a $5 billion funding round
top5.description: Mira Murati’s AI startup, Thinking Machines Lab, is seeking to raise $5 billion at a $40 billion pre-money valuation. Accel is leading the round, which could more than triple the company’s valuation.
top5.why: Thinking Machines Lab’s proposed $5 billion funding round at a $40 billion valuation would signal that private-market appetite for frontier-AI companies remains exceptionally strong despite growing concerns about AI spending.

top5.title: Baidu opens the files for its ERNIE 5.5 Flash base model
top5.description: Baidu is providing researchers with the open files for a 280-billion-parameter model, with 14 billion activated per token. ERNIE 5.5 Flash base has a one-million-token context window and can be fine-tuned.
top5.why: Baidu’s release of a 280-billion-parameter, one-million-token-context model strengthens China’s open-model ecosystem and increases competitive pressure on Western AI providers.

top5.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber, a model specialized in hacking
top5.description: GPT-6 Cyber is a version of GPT-6 Astra designed to identify security vulnerabilities and write exploits. It scored 48.5% on ExploitGym, compared with 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber, but access remains limited through Daybreak Red.
top5.why: OpenAI’s specialized cyber model demonstrates rapidly improving AI-assisted vulnerability research while raising the stakes for defensive security, misuse controls and access restrictions.

top5.title: Anthropic signs its first licensing deal with the Associated Press
top5.description: Anthropic has reached an agreement with the Associated Press allowing Claude to display midterm election results with their sources. The decision marks a shift in position after the company invoked fair use to collect news content.
top5.why: Anthropic’s first licensing agreement with the Associated Press suggests that major AI companies are shifting from broad fair-use claims toward negotiated deals with news publishers.
